reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Oral screening by low-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) testing (CPT code 87623*) is NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Oral screening by gene expression profiling by ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing (CPT code 0296U**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

87623* Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Human Papillomavirus (HPV), low-risk types (eg, 6, 11, 42, 43, 44) 0296U** Oncology (oral and/or oropharyngeal cancer), gene expression profiling by RNA sequencing at least 20 molecular features (eg, human and/or microbial mRNA), saliva, algorithm reported as positive or negative for signature associated with malignancy

*The payment criterion for 87623 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Palmetto GBA; Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance

Corporation; CGS Administrators, LLC; and Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC.

**The payment criterion for 0296U applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Palmetto GBA; Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance
